final: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.ordertune), shares AS (SELECT ordertune, execution_count, execution_count * 1.0 / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share FROM type_counts), scored AS (SELECT ordertune, execution_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(execution_count) AS sum_of_counts, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM scored WHERE share > average_share
